{
  "subject_template": "Early Payment Offer for {INVOICE_NO} with {VENDOR}",
  "body_template": "Dear {VENDOR},

We hope this message finds you well. As a valued partner, we're pleased to offer you a {DISC_PCT} discount on your invoice {INVOICE_NO} for prompt payment. By settling the amount of {AMOUNT} by {PAY_BY}, you'll save {SAVINGS} and enjoy instant payment via RTP. This offer is valid for {NET_DAYS} days from the invoice date. We look forward to your swift response.

Best regards,
Accounts Payable"
}
